newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Freight Index extends advance, up seven.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Freight Index extends advance, up seven.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) gained seven points to 1,076 on Tuesday in fairly quiet trading, although brokers noted significant demand for panamax and handy-sizes from U.S. Gulf and the Continent.
Rates are expected to pick up in both these areas near-term.
Brokers said South America remained weak but they saw signs of improvement for capers. Relatively high fresh tonnage was reported this morning.
BIFFEX futures at 1230 GMT were unchanged to 10 points firmer where traded. Total volume was 79 lots.
